ns2:course.label: Mexican-American History
ns2:course.description: Examination of the history of Mexican Americans living within the United States from the Spanish Conquest to the twentieth century. Explores the process of migration, settlement, assimilation, and discrimination with emphasis on continuity and change in Mexican cultural development. Same as LLS 279.
ns2:course.sectionDegreeAttributes: Hist&Philosoph Perspect, and US Minority Culture(s) course.
